Name: Zabad, Son of Tahath
Summary: Son of Tahath and father of Shuthelah in Ephraim's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:21: Son of Tahath and father of Shuthelah in Ephraim's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zabad stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
